import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source file, transform and append to dfs
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read source CSV
    df_source = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Extract 'V_GENE' from 'J_CALL' by splitting on '*' and taking the first part
    df_transformed = pd.DataFrame()
    df_transformed['V_GENE'] = df_source['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    
    dfs.append(df_transformed)

# Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
df_target = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
